entry_state: The disposal case reconciles parent/NCI income, period OCI, gross transactions and removal of the subsidiary's cash. Its implementation representation binds exact entity books, rates, control intervals and separate disposal branches. Atomic publication, exact retries and corrected evidence views preserve that accounting history; actual authority, valuation and storage-system validation remain required.
exit_state: Chapter10 closes by retaining currency exposure after loan elimination, matching each elimination to its transaction, restating purchasing power before translation and assessing exchangeability by purpose and date. Fixed conditional methods preserve their source and applicability limits. The next chapter must connect these company and group histories to credit losses, bank liquidity and regulatory capital.
findings: The loan example isolates remeasurement of established carrying amounts, avoiding an implied face-value rule for a new long-term loan.
Equal balances do not establish matching transactions; source allocations and control intervals prevent double use and false eliminations.
The monetary-loss derivation states its constant-exposure scope, then explains dated turnover and first-application deferred tax before translation.
The exchangeability section identifies the later amendment and distinguishes numerical consequences of a supplied estimate from evidence that it meets the estimation objective.
Chapter10 has no additional confirmed local defect. R347-D01 remains the pending notation repair.
